name: PairTalk
description: Independent IELTS speaking practice with other learners. Register and accept the Terms of Use PDF in Telegram, then use the authenticated Mini App dashboard.
capabilities: Partner matching based on practice preferences and availability
Self-assessed whole-band practice preferences from 5 to 9
Voice calls using WebRTC transport encryption
Partner aliases, post-call ratings, and reporting
Published Stars and UZS plan comparison
Aggregate statistics with definitions and dated snapshots
access: Public documents need no account. Dashboard and admin access require authentication; this metadata defines no agent actions.
